# acli-py git

Name branches and commits after issues.


## `acli-py git branch`

Print a branch name for an issue: fix/DEMO-1-login-fails-on-safari.

```text
acli-py git branch KEY [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
git switch -c "$(acli-py git branch DEMO-1)"
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Issue key, e.g. DEMO-1. |
| `--prefix` `TEXT` |  | Instead of fix/ or feat/ ('' for none). |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |


## `acli-py git commit-msg`

Print a Conventional Commit subject for an issue: fix: login fails on Safari (DEMO-1).

```text
acli-py git commit-msg KEY [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
git commit -m "$(acli-py git commit-msg DEMO-1)"
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Issue key, e.g. DEMO-1. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |
